name: sim_cvc5_cut_elimination_normalization
description: Cut elimination and strong normalization: principal cuts reduce complexity monotonically, cut-free proofs have bounded complexity, and normalization terminates in polynomial time. Tests UNSAT when these properties violated.

pytorch.reason: pytorch not needed; pure symbolic/logical computation via cvc5 and sympy

pyg.reason: PyG not needed; proof structure encoded as constraint variables

z3.reason: z3 not needed; cvc5 handles all SMT constraint proofs

cvc5.reason: load-bearing SMT solver for cut-elimination complexity UNSAT proofs

sympy.reason: supportive verification of Church-Rosser confluence property

clifford.reason: Clifford algebra not needed; proof theory via cvc5/sympy

geomstats.reason: geomstats not needed; no differential geometry required

e3nn.reason: e3nn not needed; no SO(3) equivariance required

rustworkx.reason: rustworkx not needed; proof structure encoded directly in constraints

xgi.reason: xgi not needed; no hypergraph structure

toponetx.reason: toponetx not needed; standard logical computations sufficient

gudhi.reason: gudhi not needed; no persistent homology required

test_principal_cut_reduces.description: Principal cut elimination reduces formula complexity (5 -> 3)

test_cutfree_complexity_bounded.description: Cut-free proof complexity (7) <= original with cuts (8)

test_normalization_termination.description: Proof with 3 cuts normalizes in >= 3 steps

test_principal_cut_no_reduction_unsat.description: Principal cut with no reduction (5 -> 5) is UNSAT; must decrease

test_principal_cut_increases_unsat.description: Principal cut increasing complexity (5 -> 8) is UNSAT

test_cutfree_exceeds_original_unsat.description: Cut-free proof (10) exceeding original with cuts (8) is UNSAT

test_normalization_too_slow_unsat.description: Normalization taking 5 steps for 2 cuts exceeds reasonable bound; UNSAT

test_sympy_church_rosser.description: Church-Rosser confluence: all reduction paths converge to same normal form (8->5)
